Bills vs Rams DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 12 · NFL Week 5 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 12, 4:52 PM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bills at Rams DraftKings Showdown: 21.6 points at $11,800 FLEX, 32.5 at captain for $17,700. In a game totaled at 54.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.6 times, and across 100,000 simulations he holds 55% of the winning-lineup credit. Matthew Stafford holds the most, at 65%. The case against Allen is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 8.9 points at an $11,800 FLEX salary.

Kyren Williams has the largest captain share: 18.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Williams at captain. The model gives him 15.5 carries and 4.5 targets. Matthew Stafford is the next captain in line, at 14.5%.

The Rams are a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 29 for the Rams and 25.5 for the Bills.

Behind Allen, Williams and Stafford, the next projections are Puka Nacua (21.0, $11,400), James Cook III (17.6, $10,600) and Davante Adams (14.1, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 12, 4:52 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Kyren Williams, LAR RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Kyren Williams holds 18.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 21.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 15.5 carries and 4.5 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.4 points with a simulated floor of 9.8 and a ceiling of 38.3. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 18.8% as the captain and 42.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Matthew Stafford, LAR QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Matthew Stafford holds 14.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 20.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Stafford averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 37.8. He holds 65% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.5% as the captain and 50.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Puka Nacua, LAR WR ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Puka Nacua holds 12.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,100 and the 21.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 26.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.0 points with a simulated floor of 9.1 and a ceiling of 40.1. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.1% as the captain and 37.4% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Bills vs Rams

Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 21.6 DraftKings points for an $11,800 FLEX salary ($17,700 at captain). The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 8.9 and a ceiling of 40.1. He holds 55% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.3% as the captain and 43.6% in a FLEX spot.

James Cook III, BUF RB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

James Cook III carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.6 DraftKings points for a $10,600 FLEX salary ($15,900 at captain). The model gives him 18.7 carries and 2.8 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Cook averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 31.5. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.9% as the captain and 33.2% in a FLEX spot.

Davante Adams, LAR WR ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Davante Adams carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.1 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). The model gives him 7.0 targets on 27.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Adams averaged 14.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 34.8. He holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.8% as the captain and 21.3% in a FLEX spot.

Dalton Kincaid, BUF TE ($6,600 FLEX / $9,900 CPT)

Dalton Kincaid carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.4 DraftKings points for a $6,600 FLEX salary ($9,900 at captain). The model gives him 5.1 targets on 19.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Kincaid averaged 13.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.4 and a ceiling of 29.8. He holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.4% as the captain and 31.1% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Colby Parkinson, LAR TE ($2,400 FLEX / $3,600 CPT)

Colby Parkinson projects for 6.0 DraftKings points at a $2,400 FLEX salary, 2.51 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.1 targets on 13.3 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Parkinson averaged 6.0 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 21.8. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.6% as the captain and 17.6% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Blake Corum, LAR RB ($3,800 FLEX / $5,700 CPT)

Blake Corum projects for 8.0 DraftKings points at a $3,800 FLEX salary, 2.09 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 9.8 carries and 1.2 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Corum averaged 8.0 points with a simulated floor of 2.7 and a ceiling of 15.1. He holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.3% as the captain and 20.7% in a FLEX spot.

Who is the best captain for the Bills vs Rams DraftKings Showdown?

Kyren Williams holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 18.8%, ahead of Matthew Stafford (14.5%) and Puka Nacua (12.1%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Bills vs Rams?

Build around Colby Parkinson at captain with Josh Allen, Kyren Williams and Puka Nacua at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (170 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $13,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Bills vs Rams DraftKings Showdown?

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 21.6 DraftKings points for $11,800 at FLEX, or 32.5 points at captain for $17,700.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Bills vs Rams Showdown?

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Bills vs Rams DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Colby Parkinson (6.0 points at $2,400), Blake Corum (8.0 points at $3,800) and Tyler Higbee (8.8 points at $4,400).

What is the Bills vs Rams spread and total?

The Rams are a 3.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 54.5, with implied team totals of 29 for the Rams and 25.5 for the Bills.
